fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly (LLY) fell 2.54% to $1,273.46 on October 23; Q3 earnings released on October 29 with revenue consensus of approximately $22.6 billion (slight decrease from $22.97 billion in Q2).
fields.summary_ko.1: Adjusted EPS expected at $6.70 (vs. $8.38 in Q2), with recent 5-quarter consensus beat rate of 6–11%, facing price pressure from semaglutide generic launch and China medical insurance coverage.
fields.summary_ko.2: Global capacity increased 60% in Q2 but prices fell 13%; Mounjaro captured 30% or more of new patients, with sustained strong demand in diabetes and obesity markets.
